body:
Avicus Staff Application:

(Googolplexy/Henry)


Age: 15

Timezone: EST (eastern standard time)

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes depending on the time of day, late at night I will most likely not be on TS except maybe to chill. As for using a mic in TS I’ll be using it during the day but not at night out of respect for my family needing some quiet time. So for pretty much the whole day I’d be on TS if T’m on the server

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes, Skype is an easy way to access me because I have it on my phone and laptop so it’ll be easy to contact me wherever I am

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: No, I can’t even really use one since my laptop isn’t the best for even gameplay (it does the job, on the server I get 60-120 fps) but if I record it’ll be so laggy I don’t think it will be possible to tell what’s going on in the video


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

Yes, I used to staff on an OP Factions/Prison server named ThunderMeow (the owner’s name was rockyroad83) for a little while. I’ve also had good staff friends that have showed me how to identify hacks and do basic SSing (I am not good at SSing at all fyi, but I know the basics) as well as my brother interstates that used to be staff (I believe Head-Mod or Admin)  on ParaPvP before he resigned.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness that I can see affecting my moderating would probably be my tendency to say some things in chat. I am usually a chill player and don’t really speak in chat unless to talk to people I recognize on the server or if there is just that one player that just gets under my skin. If my biggest weakness is not that then it is most likely being able to be on for a majority of my time for the day (I will still be active by coming on at least 5 days a week but I’m talking about spending an hour+ on the server on certain days since I’m ‘addicted’ to the pvp life). My biggest strength would be that I will most likely be one of the more active staff in that I am on usually when no staff are on so that’ll probably help the server with dealing with players that do not follow the rules when no staff are on. Another one of my biggest strengths is being pretty good about punishments and verbal warnings. Usually I’ll just message a player to calm down if they are toxic in chat (I can’t stand toxicity btw) and if they do it again I’ll just warn them and continue on with the punishments. As for cheaters with not so blatant clients I’m really good on identifying sketchy hits and movements and other related things.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

My main benefit to the staff team would be activity. As a player I know how annoying and frustrating it can get when no staff are on and there is a cheater on the server. Another benefit I can bring to the staff team would probably be the ability to at least be able to do basic Screensharing (SSing)


What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

A leader needs to be able to make sure they can be lenient but rigid with their followers. This means that they should be flexible in how they deal with others but have a hard stand on what they expect. I kind of consider myself a leader in the sense that in real life I am lenient with how I let my friends treat me or how others perceive me but rigid in the sense that I let them know where I draw the line at.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Attributes that distinguish me from other staff include my personality in which I see the good in people even if I’ve never known them ever in my life. Another thing that sets me apart from other players is that unlike some staff I have seen, I’ll probably spend most of my time on the server playing with the other players while offering assistance rather than just sit in spectator mode and make staffing to be a thing that isn’t enjoyable. I want being a mod to be fun and enjoyable for everyone, not to be a chore and a burden.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

First things first, everyone should have basic communication skills just as listening, talking, and feedback. I definitely do have these skills and a bit more including building relationships, creating communities and joking around. That last one is most important to me because I want to be a staff member that is fun to talk to and approachable, not a stickler who is way too serious for regular staffing.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?

Depends on how much schoolwork I have (next to none). Some days (typically weekdays) I can commit about 2-3 hours and others (weekends/breaks) I can commit a whole 7 hours to being staff. Ideally I can commit a minimum of 2.5 hours on the server like I usually do but spend a majority of that staffing.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

My first instinct would be to just ban the player off of the fact they are ban evading when they are supposed to be banned from the server. Knowing that I cannot IP-ban as a Jr Mod, I will stay on until a higher staff who CAN IP-ban comes on. If I cannot gain access to a higher staff member I will have a note in a Discord or on a group chat notifying someone to IP-ban that player ASAP. If that player is using an alt generator or something related to that I will be on the server until they decide they have had enough and stop using alts.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

If it is a lower ranked staff member such as a Jr Mod, I’ll probably ask them to stop being a nuisance to the players on TS and let them be. Afterwards I’ll warn him for it and report it to whoever I need to so they can deal with it and do whatever punishment is necessary. If he continues doing it I’ll get someone to ban him off the TS or from that team channel so they can’t do it again and if it continues somehow I’ll ask to get them demoted since they want to play games and be toxic to players when their one job is to not do that but rather help players.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

I will ask them to please appeal again. Even though I know with all my heart they did break the rules and should take the punishment given to them, it is unfair to the player if I don’t give them at least a chance (even if it’s not a fair chance) instead of me just denying their appeal based on the fact the file was corrupted. I am all about giving players at least a chance even if I believe that they didn’t earn or deserve a chance to appeal the punishment.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

Since it is not very important or confidential, I will most likely not make a huge deal about it and will just warn the staff member to not do it again and notify a higher staff member of what the team mate did so then the higher staff can sort it out with them. If it is something like a leak to an upcoming event no one is supposed to know about yet I’ll kind of treat it seriously but in all honesty if it’s like a map release or a new gamemode release I will probably not make too much of a deal about it besides telling the staff/team member not to do it again and to ask higher staff what to do about it.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

I will probably say just one little thing about it and leave it at that. If the majority of the Senior team absolutely love it then I will let them have their way with the server, but if the decision makes any negative impact onto the players I will voice out my disapproval and let them know what they need to change about it. But since I only know a few details besides word of mouth, I will hold any opinion until I get enough information to make at least a decent thought instead of looking like a goof and talking about something I know nothing about.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

It would mean that I can benefit the server in a positive way. Being a mod would make me feel like I can finally be able to have a bigger say on the server in the terms of what should be done to help players have a better playing community and experience, what should be done to improve gameplay and what can be done to make Avicus better.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

I am pretty passionate about Avicus. Avicus is one of the few servers I play on and even though sometimes I take breaks from playing minecraft for up to a few weeks at a time, I always find myself drawn to playing on Avicus as one of the first servers I go back to. Avicus to me means a community I can usually go to whenever I am bored or need to have a good time.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

I understand most spanish but do not speak it fluently. I am hispanic on both sides of my family and have taken 9ish years of spanish and been to El Salvador a total of 3 times for an extended period of time.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I would like to thank the Senior Staff team for taking the time to read my long application and that even if I am not accepted, I will not hold anything against you guys ;). Another thing is that because I can be prone to taking longish breaks from the server does not EVER mean I won’t come back. If I feel like I can not come I will talk to other staff to see if I really want to not be staff and make a final decision from there. I love the community on Avicus and believe that Avicus is (and I am not saying this to be a suckup or to be accepted easier) by far, one of my favorite servers due to the fact I can never find myself bored of playing on there. The only reasons I leave is to get better at PVP but I usually will almost always come on to practice. Now you guys can have a round of applause after reading my staff application and rest your eyes, you guys deserve it :)


PS: You guys can call me Henry if that’s easier for you, I tend to change my ign a lot but from now on I’ll keep from changing it as often. I will also try to make it close to “Henry” as possible so I can be easily identified
